# CKW Elements

CKW Elements is CKW's React design system. Use it through package imports, not copied Storybook output.

## Repository Resources

- Agent instructions: AGENTS.md
- Architecture: ARCHITECTURE.md
- Pipeline guide: PIPELINE.md
- Token package: packages/tokens
- Component package: packages/components
- Storybook app: apps/storybook
- Deployed-agent entrypoint: apps/storybook/public/llms.txt
- CKW Figma design system: https://www.figma.com/design/wGx1Y74QZIsy40UATyN6bI/%F0%9F%92%A0-CKW-Elements-%C2%B7-Design-System

## Package Usage

```css
@import '@ckwag/tokens/tokens.css';
```

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import { Button, InlineMessage, InputField, SegmentedControl } from '@ckwag/components';
```

## Core Rules

- Components use semantic tokens only.
- Do not use primitive color tokens in product components.
- Brand color is green, not blue.
- Font is Gotham through `var(--font-family-brand), sans-serif`.
- Keep `import React from 'react';` in TSX files in this repository.
- Do not introduce Turborepo, Nx, Tailwind, ESLint, or test runners unless explicitly requested.
